items.title: I am pleased to nominate Joseph Falvey to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Northern District of Indiana. Joe is currently an Assistant U.S. Attorney, where he has done an incredible job protecting Public Safety, and promoting Law and Order. Joe is a graduate of Yale Law School and the University of Notre Dame, and previously clerked for three esteemed Jurists, Chief Justice of the United States Supreme Court, John Roberts, Judge Thomas Griffith of the D.C. Circuit, and Judge Dabney Friedrich of The United States District Court for the District of Columbia. He is also a Marine Corps Veteran and Pat Tillman Scholar. Joe will strongly protect our cherished Constitution and Rule of Law in this important new role. Congratulations Joe! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.title: I am pleased to nominate Eric Hamilton to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the District of Nebraska. Eric has done a phenomenal job as the Deputy Assistant Attorney General for the Federal Programs Branch, defending our Administration’s most important Policies in Court. A sixth generation Nebraskan, Eric previously served as Solicitor General of the State of Nebraska. He is a proud graduate of Stanford Law School and the University of Nebraska, and clerked for the highly respected Judge Thomas Hardiman of the Third Circuit. The incredible people of Nebraska are lucky to have a fighter like Eric join the Federal Bench. Congratulations Eric! President DONALD J. TRUMP
